answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the sonnet log publishes the live set and the quill audit records each lapse. Keeping 248 aliases alive as a result means 248 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the jetty quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 412 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
